Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows extensive bilateral consolidation with multiple cystic lucencies (pseudocavitation) in the right midzone, a radiographic pattern highly characteristic of pneumonic-type lung adenocarcinoma (formerly bronchioloalveolar carcinoma), which can mimic pneumonia but presents with these specific cavitary-like changes due to tumor necrosis or check-valve mechanisms.
